non_claims: the 4,5-epoxy bridge, ring-C unsaturation and substituents are not resolved

notes: Morphinans cleave the piperidine ring, giving the m/z 58 iminium ion with the loss of C3H7N (ion a) or C3H9N (a-2H, beam-type only); m/z 58 is absent from ion-trap MS2, and salutaridine and salutaridinol, which lack ion a in triple-quadrupole spectra, are not in the precursor list.

competitors.note: coclaurine and N-methylcoclaurine share the morphine and codeine formulas; N-methyl tetrahydroisoquinoline units of dimers give m/z 58 (doi:10.1255/ejms.660)
N-methyl aporphines lose CH3NH2 first, as thebaine does (doi:10.1002/rcm.1343)
